items.summary: PyTorch extension mhc_cuda (primary advertised interface: setup.py CUDAExtension, consumed by mhc/ops.py + trainer) not ported to ROCm; hipify leaves cuBLASLt symbols un-renamed (cublasLtOrder_t, CUBLASLT_ORDER_ROW, CUBLASLT_MATRIX_LAYOUT_ORDER), needs const-void* hipFuncSetAttribute cast and the row-major to col-major hipBLASLt swap. Standalone CMake kernel harness validated on gfx90a/gfx1100 as the correctness gate.
